14a_BadField.def: Unsupported legacy invalid-tag policy: the parser ignores noncanonical zero/negative tag syntax; default user-defined tags >=5000 are permitted. Fixture expects numeric Rejects and disallows all user tags.
14e_IncorrectEnumValue.def: Unsupported QuickFIX test application echo after the enum rejection probes; FXP returns ExecutionReport and uses integer order quantities instead of echoing 002000.00.
15_HeaderAndBodyFieldsOrderedDifferently: Unsupported QuickFIX application echo of a NewOrderSingle without OrderQty; FXP business-rejects missing quantity.
19a_PossResendMessageThatHAsAlreadyBeenS: Unsupported QuickFIX application echo/PossResend deduplication fixture; FXP uses matching-engine execution reports, not an echo service.
Unsupported QuickFIX application echo for PossResend; fixture order lacks the quantity FXP requires.
1b_DuplicateIdentity.def: Unsupported silent duplicate-session disconnect policy: FXP sends an explicit rejection Logout before closing the second connection.
1c_InvalidSenderCompID.def: Unsupported silent authentication rejection policy: FXP sends an explicit Logout for an unknown CompID.
1c_InvalidTargetCompID.def: Unsupported silent invalid-target rejection policy: FXP sends an explanatory Logout.
1d_InvalidLogonBadSendingTime.def: Unsupported silent invalid-Logon-time rejection policy: FXP sends an explanatory Logout before disconnect.
1d_InvalidLogonWrongBeginString.def: Unsupported silent version rejection policy: the FIX4.4-only acceptor sends an explanatory Logout.
1e_NotLogonMessage.def: Unsupported silent first-message rejection policy: FXP explicitly logs out a connection whose first message is not Logon.
20_SimultaneousResendRequest.def: Unsupported QuickFIX application echo required before the simultaneous resend portion; FXP does not echo orders missing quantity.
21_RepeatingGroupSpecifierWithValueOfZer: Unsupported SecurityDefinition echo/application handling (explicitly out of scope). Zero-count group validation is supported, but 35=d is not an FXP application message.
2d_GarbledMessage.def: Unsupported QuickFIX application echo after the garbled-message probe; fixture valid follow-up order lacks OrderQty.
2f_PossDupOrigSendingTimeTooHigh.def: Unsupported QuickFIX application echo required before the PossDup timestamp probe; FXP requires OrderQty.
2g_PossDupNoOrigSendingTime.def: Unsupported QuickFIX application echo required before the missing OrigSendingTime probe; FXP requires OrderQty.
2i_BeginStringValueUnexpected.def: Unsupported wait-for-peer-Logout behavior after fatal BeginString mismatch: FXP flushes Logout and closes; peer's subsequent Logout can encounter TCP reset.
2k_CompIDDoesNotMatchProfile.def: Unsupported wait-for-peer-Logout behavior after fatal CompID mismatch: FXP emits Reject/Logout then closes instead of waiting for the peer's Logout.
2m_BodyLengthValueNotCorrect.def: Unsupported QuickFIX application echo after BodyLength recovery; FXP rejects the follow-up order for missing quantity.
2o_SendingTimeValueOutOfRange.def: Unsupported wait-for-peer-Logout behavior after fatal SendingTime accuracy failure: FXP sends Reject/Logout and closes, so the fixture's Logout can encounter TCP reset.
3b_InvalidChecksum.def: Unsupported QuickFIX application echo after checksum recovery; FXP requires quantity on the follow-up order.
3c_GarbledMessage.def: Unsupported QuickFIX application echo: the valid follow-up market order is executed/canceled by FXP, not echoed as 35=D.
4a_NoDataSentDuringHeartBtInt.def: Unsupported exact QuickFIX heartbeat cadence; FXP's quarter-interval monitor and 20-percent peer grace can issue TestRequest before the fixture's second expected heartbeat.
6_SendTestRequest.def: Unsupported fixed QuickFIX TestReqID=TEST/cadence; FXP generates a unique TestReqID and requires the same ID in the reply.
8_AdminAndApplicationMessages.def: Unsupported QuickFIX application echo and subsequent replay of echoed orders; FXP produces execution reports.
8_OnlyAdminMessages.def: Unsupported repeated ResendRequest with already-consumed sequence 5 after sequence 6; FXP rejects low-sequence non-PossDup messages.
8_OnlyApplicationMessages.def: Unsupported QuickFIX application echo/resend fixture; the inbound order lacks the quantity FXP requires.
AlreadyLoggedOn.def: Unsupported silent second Logon rejection policy: FXP sends an explanatory Logout for its low sequence number.
RejectResentMessage.def: Unsupported buffering of out-of-order administrative messages: FXP requests replay rather than retaining TestRequest sequence 3 for automatic processing after the gap closes.
ReverseRoute.def: Unsupported OnBehalfOf/DeliverTo routing-field reversal on Reject; routed third-party FIX sessions are not implemented.
ReverseRouteWithEmptyRoutingTags.def: Unsupported OnBehalfOf/DeliverTo routing reversal; dictionary empty-value validation works but Reject does not reverse routing headers.
